regressions.baseline_observed: A GC calling a missing role suspended its only running session. Draining left no running agent, with the role request still queued to that GC and no launch continuation.
fixed_assertions: The same request retry retains its recorded request identity.
The GC receives the role request and can commission its Role Creator.
The creator is a member of the GC team and can launch at configured capacity one.

regressions.baseline_observed: With worker configured in roles_without_authority, ordinary delegation raised Stop but role commissioning succeeded.
fixed_assertions: Both CLI and MCP commission paths refuse the currently blacklisted worker role.
Assignments, requests, transitions and work records stay unchanged after refusal.
Removing worker from the configured blacklist allows that same request to be commissioned.

scope: Public orchestration verbs and real isolated work/prompt stores, using the existing deterministic Transport. These are state/continuation contract tests; process-level and real-model evidence is reported separately.
